bot.name: IPO GMP Alerts Bot: Custom GMP Filter
bot.short_description: Get IPO GMP alerts filtered your way: Mainboard or SME, above your GMP %. Daily list: @ipogmpalerts
bot.description:
Tired of scrolling through every IPO? Set your filter once and get only the IPOs that match.

✅ Pick Mainboard, SME or both
✅ Set your minimum GMP
✅ Get GMP + subscription status every market day at 11:00 AM

Free, no signup.
📢 Full daily list: @ipogmpalerts

GMP is unofficial grey market data. Not investment advice.

welcome.title: IPO GMP Alerts
welcome.tagline: Only the IPOs that pass your filters.
welcome.daily: Every market day at 11:00 AM you get one message per IPO that passes your filters (board + GMP %).
welcome.none: If IPOs are open but none pass, you get one line telling you to stay out. If no IPOs are open, you get no message.
welcome.channel: Don't want filters? The channel posts every open IPO at 10:00 AM.
welcome.full_list: 📢 Full daily list of all IPOs: @ipogmpalerts
welcome.buttons_hint: ⚙️ Settings shows your filters. Tap a GMP % or Type % for any number.

help.title: How IPO GMP Alerts works
help.daily: • 11:00 AM on market days: one message per IPO that passes your filters.
help.closing: • 🔴 marks IPOs closing today. They come first.
help.none:
• IPOs open but none pass: one 🚫 message. Stay out that day.
• No IPOs open: no message.
help.check: • 🔎 Check now: the IPOs passing your filters right now.
help.settings: • ⚙️ Settings or /filter: choose Mainboard / SME / Both, then the minimum GMP %. Tap a preset or Type % for a custom number. Subscription is not a filter.
help.channel: • 📢 Channel: every open IPO at 10:00 AM, no filters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint_main: Choose Mainboard GMP % below. Subscription is not used.
settings.hint_sme: Choose SME GMP % below. Subscription is not used.
settings.hint_both: Set Mainboard GMP % and SME GMP % separately. Subscription is not used.
settings.tap_hint: Tap a preset, or tap Type % and send any number from 0 to 300.
settings.filters_use: Your filters above drive the 11:00 AM messages and Check now.

gmp_prompt.body: Send any percentage you want, for example {example}.
gmp_prompt.retry: Send a number from 0 to 300, or cancel.

feedback.thanks: Thanks. Your note was sent to the team.
